correctness.rationale: Both directed versions of each of the prism’s 9 edges produce 18 arcs. Full 2^18-mask enumeration and union-find cycle exclusion are reproduced by the source verifier. Independent face enumeration gave 686 nonempty simplices with f=(18,108,260,240,60), and reduced mod-two Betti (5,22,6). Source verify_six_cubic.py implements 323 pairs of acyclic augmented Morse matching on 687 faces and 2274 incidences, exact signed cancellation to 9 degree-2, 26 degree-3, 6 degree-4 cells, rank d3=4, d4=0, and a 4x4 unimodular minor determinant -1. Consequently all homology is integral and torsion-free. An earlier published integral zero-Morse-differential proof independently establishes the same ranks and even full wedge homotopy.
